description: "Index of artifact schemas each worker must conform to."

# Artifact Schemas

Full schema text lives in `.jira2pr/artifacts/`:

- **jira reader** produces artifacts conforming to `.jira2pr/artifacts/requirements-schema.md`
- **researcher** produces artifacts conforming to `.jira2pr/artifacts/decision-schema.md`
- **planner** produces artifacts conforming to `.jira2pr/artifacts/plan-schema.md`
- **reviewer** produces artifacts conforming to `.jira2pr/artifacts/review-schema.md`
- **pr author** produces artifacts conforming to `.jira2pr/artifacts/pr-schema.md`
